lead: Zehra Güneş has built a public profile as a Turkish volleyball player, born on 7 July 1999 in Kartal.
As of 2026, she is 27 years old, and her birth date places her under the Cancer sign.
She has represented Turkey women's national volleyball team and VakıfBank SK.
The sections that follow break down Zehra Güneş's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Zehra Güneş — Career and Professional Work
paras: Zehra Güneş works primarily as a volleyball player.

On the team sheet, Zehra has been associated with Turkey women's national volleyball team (from 2018), VakıfBank SK (from 2017) and Beşiktaş JK (women's volleyball) (from 2016 to 2017). She plays as a middle blocker.

She has taken part in 2015 Girls' Youth European Volleyball Championship, 2015 FIVB Girls Youth World Championship, 2015 FIVB Women's Junior World Championship, 2016 Women's U19 Volleyball European Championship and 2016–17 Turkish Women's Volleyball League.
